title: T3 — Closure review (record completed, 2026-11-22)
body:
# T3 — Closure review (record completed, 2026-11-22)

Project: T3 — PM job · Tranche 3 · Plan: SPEC_V2 §12 · Issue #74

## Outcome vs acceptance

SPEC_V2 §12 T3's gate — "PM runs a request end to end; cannot approve its own gate; a baseline
change requires a change request" — is met by the live rows: the charter was approved by a
distinct approver; the five deliverables carry WSJF inputs and accepted status; the scope baseline
is frozen at v1 and approved by an actor other than its taker; the acceptance of the deliverables
travelled as an approved change request (`01a2052e-5648…`), not as a direct mutation; the delivery
contract `01a2052f-29da-76c4-9bda-e45e0f408fe8` is live with a Board decision under the standing delegation; the Phase-G review
(`01a2052f-cc4e…`) is conformant and cites the published delegation; and five demo credits were
recorded at the tranche-3 demo.

The project was reopened from a vacuous closure: it had no baseline, no contract and no review.
The tr3 review recorded that condition; this closure closes it with the record, not with a waiver.

## Evidence

- Scope baseline `01a2052e-061f-7570-b780-d94101449bef` (frozen, approved by `01a1e8a7…`,
  taken by `01a1efd4…` — distinct).
- Delivery contract `01a2052f-29da-76c4-9bda-e45e0f408fe8` (live), Board decision `01a2052f-5a18…` citing the standing
  delegation `01a2021d…`.
- Phase-G review `01a2052f-cc4e…` (conformant).
- Change `01a2052e-5648…` (approved) authorising the acceptance.
- Five accepted deliverables and five demo credits on cadence `01a20280-ef3f…`.
- Tests: `crates/actions/tests/spine_gates.rs`, `closure_gate.rs`, `programme_close.rs`.
- `scripts/verify-project.py --project T3` at this snapshot: every check green except those this
  closure itself creates (the closure gate and the published output).

## Open items

- None owned by T3. The programme-level B3 benefit profile waits on T6's approved baseline (a T6
  dependency, recorded on the programme benefit evaluation); the tr4 review will read it.

## Decision

Close T3. The record is complete against its manifest; nothing is waived and no finding is
deferred.
